newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Underperform bar N.Z.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Underperform bar N.Z.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads widened against both Canada and the U.S., but New Zealand debt put in an extremely weak performance.
N.Z. yields rose sharply as it compensated for a rapid sell-off in the N.Z. dollar to keep monetary policy conditions at the RBNZ's desired level.
The extent of the spike in N.Z. yields rubbed off on the local market to some extent, as did further weakness in U.S. Treasuries in Tokyo trading, and prompted its underperformance against the U.S.

A Reuters poll of economists taken on Friday found expectations for the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread at year-end centring on a median 50 basis points, although many believe there is scope for a further narrowing before then.
Some expect that the spread can breach parity in the next couple months, and one investment bank sees the spread remaining negative to finish the year minus 50 b.p.
